description:
## Why

PKIX-7nsf.7 closed with the discovery that pyca's actual chain corpus is x509-limbo (separate repo, 9,773 testcases). The proper LimboCorpus integration is filed as PKIX-g9vc (P3, ~1-2h of work, requires per-testcase validation_time threading through all oracles).

In the meantime, downstream developers and reviewers should have a way to actually run the harness on the full x509-limbo corpus to *see* what it does end-to-end. The pieces already exist — PEM-tree corpus loader handles directory trees of chain.pem files. Bridging that to limbo.json is a small Python converter, no harness changes needed.

## What

1. `pkix-difftest/python/limbo-to-pem-tree.py`: stdlib-only Python script that reads `limbo.json` and writes one `chain.pem` (leaf + intermediates + first trust anchor) per testcase into a directory tree, plus a sibling `meta.json` capturing per-testcase metadata (`expected_result`, `validation_kind`, `validation_time`, features) for later cross-reference.
2. Filter testcases with features the harness cannot run (`has-crl`).
3. `pkix-difftest/README.md` Demo section explaining the workflow:
   - clone x509-limbo
   - run converter
   - run `pkix-difftest run pem-tree ...`
4. Document limitations clearly (validation_time ignored, expected_result not threaded through, has-crl skipped).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Converter runs on a fresh clone of C2SP/x509-limbo and writes a non-empty directory tree.
- [ ] Harness runs to completion on the converted tree (errors-per-chain are visible in the report, not silent).
- [ ] README Demo section explains the workflow and limitations.
- [ ] Script uses Python stdlib only (no cryptography or other 3rd-party deps — the venv is for pyca_oracle.py only).

## Out of scope

- Per-testcase validation_time (PKIX-g9vc).
- Expected-result threading (would require extending the PEM-tree loader's `Corpus` impl, which is harness work).
- `has-policy-constraints`, `pedantic-*` feature filtering — too granular for a demo path.

## Filed as

User-requested follow-up to PKIX-7nsf.7 ('have a path somewhere to use the entire test corpus as a demo'). Smaller-scope alternative to PKIX-g9vc that uses only existing harness pieces.
title: diff harness: demo path — limbo-to-pem-tree converter for ad-hoc full-corpus runs
